entrypoints.description: Shared source application boundary archives immutable source-derived versions without promoting claims.
Registers source/document identity and locator/content-verification state before optional raw-file materialization, reusing the same evidence.documents identity.
Reads logical source identity, retrieval context and current preservation/materialization provenance for Evidence drilldown without moving Evidence truth ownership out of CAP-0002.

extension_seams: Add SourcePlugin/transport adapters behind the existing source/archive ports.
Add source discovery/watchlist behavior without changing logical document identity semantics.
Add later materialization workers that enrich locator/content-verified documents with raw bytes only after identity/content verification.
Add storage-neutral source-identity/preservation read projections that expose existing provenance without inferring claim authority or rewriting representation identity.

guards.description: Archive regression tests preserve content-addressed/source-version behavior.
Locator lifecycle tests prevent document-version persistence from being mistaken for raw-byte materialization and keep later raw materialization explicit/version-scoped.
Materialized-source tests require truthful provenance when local bytes are a readable representation of an upstream PDF rather than the raw PDF itself.
Real PostgreSQL drilldown proves current materialization provenance can be read without relabelling the earlier Evidence representation as raw source bytes.

non_goals: Evidence claim grounding or Fact/Judgment promotion.
Treating retrieval host, a .pdf suffix, or locator existence as claim authority/content proof.
Requiring byte-identical PDF materialization before claim-relevant content that was actually read can be preserved for Evidence.
Owning Evidence fragment text, claim truth, or historical replay composition merely because source provenance is exposed to a reader.
purpose: Own source identity and preservation across locator_verified, content_verified and materialized states so readable/verifiable source information is not lost or blocked by transport friction. Preserved readable representations may create document versions without claiming raw-source materialization; later verified raw bytes enrich the same logical document explicitly. Read projections may expose that existing identity and current preservation provenance without turning operational materialization state into historical market knowledge.
revisit_when: Replace only if a stronger source-version authority preserves one logical document identity across locator/content/raw states, truthful representation provenance, immutable materialized bytes, contradiction-aware enrichment and storage-neutral provenance reads.
title: Source identity, preservation and deferred materialization
